newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures called unchanged, bias to upside.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures called unchanged, bias to upside.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures were called to open around unchanged on Thursday, with a bias to the upside, and expected to trade low volume in a narrow range, in the absence of any news overnight, brokers said.
"Brent and gas oil should come in unchanged -- maybe a touch up," one broker said. "It's been very quiet, with no overnight news."

September Brent settled 19 cents higher on Wednesday, just off the day's highs, at $18.39 a barrel after receiving a lift from U.S. product strength. U.S. gasoline rallied on spread buying and a supportive stock draw in EIA data.
IPE Gas oil settled $1.75 firmer on Wednesday at $165.00 a tonne.
NYMEX September crude futures trading on Access were last done at $19.68 a barrel, five cents higher from the pit trade settle at $19.63.
